title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-11 03:09:36 最新章节：第288章 再见山鬼
content_zh:
陈知白近来总做同一个梦。
说是同一个梦，实际上这个梦的剧情一直在发展。
他成了一名乡野少年，劈柴炊爨，牧牛捉虾，私塾诵吟……过着简朴的乡野生活。
但今天的梦，却显得有些特殊，且格外的真实。
他能清晰感觉到，一道冰冷湿滑的触感划过脖颈，好似情人的抚摸，真实的令他感到困惑。
他费力睁开眼睛。
粉纱帐暖，烛影摇曳，空气里浮着一种甜腻的暖香。
视线下移，对上一双含情的剪水眸子。
是位极美女子，眉梢眼角含着春水般的媚意，乌发如云，披散在白皙的肩头，身上只松松拢着一件绯红的纱衣，欲遮还休。
她正瞧着他，红唇微翘，吐气如兰。
“公子醒了？”
女子的声音又软又糯，酥人骨头：“胆子怎么这么不禁吓？奴家还以为你死了呢！”
随着她的话语，一大段纷乱冗杂的记忆，蛮横地挤进陈知白的脑海。
荒山偶遇，灯下倾心，抵死缠绵……以及最后红绡帐暖，情迷意乱之时，身下美人娇嫩的肌肤，倏然浮现一片片青黑色的鳞片。
绝美面庞在极致的愉悦中，扭曲形变。
记忆的最后，定格在一双竖起的蛇瞳上！
接着……惊吓，晕厥。
这梦有意思，竟拿了许仙的体验卡？
陈知白满心遗憾，梦就是梦，总会错过最精彩的部分。
他被压得有些透不过起来，下意识道：“你、你先下来，放开我。”

女子娇笑起来，冰凉指尖点在他心口，一路划过胸膛下移：
“只要你借奴家一件宝贝，奴家就放了你。”
“什么…宝贝？”
女子不言，只是划过胸膛的指尖，一路向下。
分叉的信子，若有若无地扫过他的耳垂。
“我试过很多人了，只有你……颇有几分彭祖之姿。今日借来，助我修行阴阳妖体，可好？”
陈知白神色古怪起来，这是再来一张许仙体验卡？
不等他理清这荒唐的经历，女子瞳孔陡然竖起，泛着妖冶红芒，直直刺入他眼底。
陈知白意识陡然一沉，仿佛坠入深渊，迟滞而模糊。
他还能感觉到身体，却遥远得不属于自己。
果然在做梦！
好无聊啊……总是关键时刻就转场。
女子身躯逐渐拉长，化为蛇躯，冰冷鳞片刮过身体，缠绕上他的身体。
一阵不容抗拒的韵律，在他耳旁响起：
“跟我念……”
“玄躯非私，灵府空庐，愿奉根噐，成尔道基。”
陈知白不由自主的跟着梦呓起来：“玄躯非私，灵府空庐……”
咒语起，妖风卷。
丝丝红芒从蛇妖体内渗出，落在陈知白身体及四周，松软床榻露出了本相。
——这是一方巨大石台，石台上刻满了扭曲云篆。

“愿奉根……”
女子的声音带着一丝压抑的急切与渴望。
陈知白喃喃：“愿奉……”
不对，我这可不是大圣根噐。
content_en:
Chen Zhibai always has the same dream recently.
It is said that it is the same dream, but in fact the plot of this dream has been developing.
He became a country boy, chopping firewood and cooking rice, herding cattle and catching shrimps, reciting music in private school... he lived a simple country life.
But today's dream seemed a little special and extraordinarily real.
He could clearly feel a cold, slippery touch across his neck, like a lover's touch, which truly confused him.
He struggled to open his eyes.
The pink gauze tent is warm, the candle shadows are swaying, and a sweet and warm fragrance floats in the air.
His gaze moved downwards, meeting a pair of affectionate eyes.
She is a very beautiful woman, with a charming charm like spring water in the corners of her eyebrows and eyes. Her black hair is like clouds, scattered on her fair shoulders. She is only loosely covered with a crimson gauze dress, trying to cover it up.
She was looking at him, her red lips slightly raised, and her breath was like blue.
"Master, are you awake?"
The woman's voice was soft, waxy, and crisp to the bone: "Why are you so brave? I thought you were dead!"
Following her words, a large number of confusing memories swarmed into Chen Zhibai's mind.
A chance encounter on the barren mountain, falling in love under the lamp, lingering until death...and finally the warmth of the red gauze tent, when the love is in confusion, the delicate skin of the beauty under her body suddenly appears with green-black scales.
The beautiful face was distorted in extreme pleasure.
At the end of the memory, it is fixed on a pair of erect snake eyes!
Then... frightened, fainted.
This dream is interesting. I actually got Xu Xian’s experience card?
Chen Zhibai was full of regrets. Dreams are just dreams and they will always miss the best part.
He was so suppressed that he subconsciously said: "You, you come down first and let me go."
The woman smiled sweetly, and touched his heart with her cold fingertips, moving all the way down his chest:
"As long as you borrow a treasure from the slave family, the slave family will let you go."
"What...baby?"
The woman didn't say anything, she just traced her fingertips across her chest, all the way down.
The forked letter brushed his earlobe vaguely.
"I have tried many people, but you are the only one... who looks a bit like Peng Zu. Can you borrow it today to help me practice the Yin-Yang Demonic Body?"
Chen Zhibai looked strange. Is this another Xu Xian experience card?
Before he could sort out this ridiculous experience, the woman's pupils suddenly stood up, glowing with a coquettish red light, piercing directly into his eyes.
Chen Zhibai's consciousness suddenly sank, as if falling into an abyss, sluggish and blurry.
He could still feel his body, but it was so far away that it didn't belong to him.
I am indeed dreaming!
It's so boring...it always changes at the critical moment.
The woman's body gradually elongated and turned into a snake body. Cold scales scraped across her body and wrapped around his body.
An irresistible rhythm sounded in his ears:
"Remember me..."
"The mysterious body is not private. The spiritual mansion is an empty house. I am willing to worship it and become the foundation of your Tao."
Chen Zhibai couldn't help but start mumbling along with his dream: "The mysterious body is not private, the spiritual mansion is empty..."
The spell rises, and the evil wind rolls around.
A trace of red light seeped out from the body of the snake demon, falling on Chen Zhibai's body and surroundings, and the soft bed revealed its true appearance.
——This is a huge stone platform, which is covered with twisted cloud seals.
"I would like to serve my roots..."
The woman's voice contained a hint of suppressed eagerness and desire.
Chen Zhibai murmured: "I would like to serve..."
No, I am not the Great Saint.
